existing.issue: Wrong location — Antagarh is in Kanker district ~150 km north of Jagdalpur, not 40 km south. The real Gond/Dhurwa/Bhatra tribal homestay near Jagdalpur is Shakeel Rizvi's 'Bastar Tribal Homestay' at Chhote Bodal village, Post Nangur, 23 km from Jagdalpur. Verified on Homestays of India, Village Square, Expedia and Agoda.

replacement.name: Bastar Tribal Homestay (Chhote Bodal)
replacement.tagline: Eco-architecture homestay run by Shakeel Rizvi (since 2010) at Chhote Bodal village, 23 km from Jagdalpur — mud walls, clay floors, stone roofs, bamboo elements. ₹700/person/night plus meals cooked on wood fire by a women's self-help group, served on Sal-leaf plates. The lived experience of Dhurwa, Bhatra, Muria and Gond tribal life — handicraft workshops, traditional cooking, farm activities, guided forest walks. Tokapal Tribal Market (25km) and Kanger Valley NP (30km) on the same loop.
replacement.address: Bastar Tribal Homestay, Village Chhote Bodal, Kawalikala, Post Nangur, Jagdalpur, Bastar District, Chhattisgarh 494005

existing.name: Hareli Eco Resort, Mohda
existing.issue: Cross-dest contamination — Hareli Eco Resort is at Mohda inside Barnawapara Wildlife Sanctuary, NOT 35 km from Sirpur. Actual road distance Sirpur to Mohda gate ≈ 65-80 km depending on route, not the 35 km claimed. The pairing argument (do Sirpur + Barnawapara from one base) is real, but Hareli should be slotted on Barnawapara, not Sirpur. Re-anchor Sirpur location slot on Aloha Nature Stay, which is the legitimate Sirpur-edge resort on the Sirpur River.

replacement.name: Aloha Nature Stay
replacement.tagline: 20-room private resort on the Sirpur River at the Barnawapara forest fringe — 50.3 km from Raipur Airport, 18 minutes to Lakshmana Temple. Nine garden-view cottages plus Standard/Suite/Wooden Suite categories; in-house kitchen cooks tribal-flavoured pure-veg menu from a farm-grown organic plot. The legitimate Sirpur-side stay for travellers who want a single base before driving on to Barnawapara the next morning — without faking proximity.
replacement.address: Aloha Nature Stay, Jalki, Sirpur, Mahasamund District, Chhattisgarh 493445
